Synopsis:
    10-year Treasury yields (~4.73%) are approaching a critical technical resistance at 4.7478% following a breakout from a symmetrical triangle pattern. A break above opens targets at 4.809% (Jan 2025 high), then 5.021% (Oct 2023 peak). Support sits at 4.52–4.53%. Fed Chair Warsh has edged closer to signaling potential rate hikes to combat price pressures, reinforcing the bullish yield narrative.
